name: Structured Long Postal Address 1
definition: Address of a party expressed in a formal structure, usually according to the country's postal services specifications.

BuildingName.name: Building Name
BuildingName.definition: Name of the building or house.

StreetName.name: Street Name
StreetName.definition: Name of a street or thoroughfare.

StreetBuildingIdentification.name: Street Building Identification
StreetBuildingIdentification.definition: Number that identifies the position of a building on a street.

Floor.name: Floor
Floor.definition: Floor or storey within a building.

TownName.name: Town Name
TownName.definition: Name of a built-up area, with defined boundaries, and a local government.

DistrictName.name: District Name
DistrictName.definition: Name of a district, that is, a part of a town or region.

RegionIdentification.name: Region Identification
RegionIdentification.definition: Identification of an administrative division of a country, state, or territory.

State.name: State
State.definition: Organised political community or area forming a part of a federation.

PostCodeIdentification.name: Post Code Identification
PostCodeIdentification.definition: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

PostOfficeBox.name: Post Office Box
PostOfficeBox.definition: Numbered box in a post office, assigned to a person or organisation, where letters are kept until called for.

StreetNameAndOrPostOfficeBoxRule.definition: If StreetName is not present, then PostOfficeBox is mandatory. If StreetName is present, then PostOfficeBox is optional.
